task_definition.task_description:
Please check Alice’s availability for January 15, 2026, then book Conference Room A from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM for 8 attendees. After that, look up an Office room option for at least 8 people at 2:00 PM that day and publish that room ticket to my app as high priority, then scan the living room smart devices, send me the scan result as a high-priority app alert, set the living room light brightness to 70%, and unlock the main lock with PIN 2026.

Then find Alice’s contact details, prepare and send her an email saying the meeting room is confirmed and the room setup is ready. Finally, get the latest business news and return the first headline.

user_input.query: Please check Alice’s availability using calendar user ID u_alice for 2026-01-15, then book Conference Room A from 14:00 to 15:00 for 8 attendees. After that, find an Office room option for at least 8 people at 14:00 on 2026-01-15 and publish that room ticket to my app for user_01 with high priority on the app channel. Then scan the smart devices in the living_room, send me the scan result as a high-priority app alert, set light_living brightness to 70, and unlock lock_main by setting it to unlock with PIN 2026. Finally, find Alice’s contact details, prepare and send her an email to alice with the subject “Meeting room confirmed” and the message “Your meeting room is booked and the room setup is ready.” Then get the latest business news in the business category and return the first headline.
user_input.final_message: Your meeting room is booked and the room setup is ready.
